race.comment: MACIEK (7) comes off an average run last start when fifth at this track over 390m behind Beautiful Star (22.78). Can atone. TING TONG CABANG (8) was safely held last time out, finishing fifth at this track over 390m behind Somber (23.02) in a Maiden. Some good form is emerging from her last run. Cannot be underestimated. HARTLAND MAISIE (1) boxed on well to finish third last time, beaten 0.8 lengths (22.96) behind Ripley Riot at Ballarat. Will give a great sight again. PAW BETTY (2) returns after a break and looks a top-three hope.
